explanation: Emperor Honorius moved the court there from Milan in 402, partly because marshes made it easy to defend. Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus there in 476.

claims.text: In 476, when Romulus Augustulus was deposed, Ravenna was the capital of the Western Roman Empire.
Rome, Milan and Trier were not the Western imperial capital in 476, though Milan had been until 402.
Emperor Honorius moved the western imperial court from Milan to Ravenna in 402.
Ravenna's surrounding marshes made it easy to defend.
Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus at Ravenna in 476.
